code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (very low arterial pH and oxygen saturation), consistent with acute respiratory failure. There is pancytopenia (low leukocytes, neutrophils, lymphocytes, and platelets) and mild normocytic, hypochromic anemia with increased red cell distribution width, suggesting possible bone marrow dysfunction or acute illness. Marked monocytosis and basophilia are present. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are strongly recommended.
